text:
sara: pset80 nightly eval shows ~9% drop on Anchor Coverage after yesterday's promptset v80 merge (commit f3a9b2). Noticed it for rw-13b-quant8 and rw-13b-int8. Anyone available to look? https://ci.redwood/internal/job/pset80-nightly (job 1709199900)

mike: saw the alert this morning. failures concentrated on anchor examples containing short-preface phrases like 'Use the following' and 'Preferred answer'. quick sample diffs look like anchor wording moved around so exact-match coverage tanked. :eyes:

jia: I can bisect the promptset+tokenizer commits today. initial hunch: recent tokenizer change that deduped whitespace tokens may have shifted anchor boundaries. tagging @alvin

alvin: i ran a tiny compare across tokenizer commits — v2.2 -> v2.3 changed tokenization around punctuation and abbreviations. that can nudge generation framing for short anchors (e.g., "e.g.," and list prefixes).

eval-bot: Nightly eval job 1709199900 finished. Metrics snapshot: anchor_coverage: baseline 0.84 -> current 0.76 (-9.5%). Full metrics: https://ci.redwood/internal/results/1709199900

sara: if tokenizer is the culprit that would explain both fp16 and quantized models showing the drop (embedding/kv boundaries change). jia can you run a smoke with the old tokenizer + rw-13b-fp16 to isolate quantization vs tokenization?

jia: starting smoke now: `./scripts/run_eval --pset pset80 --commit f3a9b2 --tokenizer=tokenizer-v2.2 --model=rw-13b-fp16` ETA ~18m

mike: if this is an anchor-boundary shift we should avoid doing a rebaseline. prefer reverting tokenizer change or updating anchors to be canonicalized first. rebaseline would hide a user-visible behavior change. :thinking_face:

jia: smoke done. results: fp16 w/ old tokenizer -> anchor_coverage 0.83 (within nightly noise). so root cause is tokenizer v2.3 change, not quantization. dumping a couple of examples:
```
id: 12345
expected: "Use the following steps to..."
got: "Usethese steps to..."
```

alvin: confirmed. tokenizer v2.3 merged on infra PR 987. the change collapsed a narrow whitespace case in our tokenizer normalization. I'll open a revert PR on release branch and add a unit test around anchor token boundaries.

sara: ok — let's block any further pset80 merges until revert lands. do NOT rebaseline the pset. @product please note this will delay the rollout until we fix the tokenizer or update canonical anchors.

jia: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1012 — revert tokenizer v2.3 normalization, includes regression test and a small eval smoke.

mike: thanks. prioritizing the revert on CI queue now. once merged we can rerun nightly and confirm metrics recover. :thumbsup:
